snippet.title: Daniel Parker's Presentation on Serverless Forums - Part 2 (Algolia, Firebase & Lambda)
snippet.description: http://acloud.guru launched a year ago with a few thousand students and has since grown to over 120 thousand students. This talk is about how A Cloud Guru has re-engineered their serverless forums using AWS Lambda and Algolia Search to supercharge search and query speed (no relational databases were harmed in the making of these forums).

snippet.title: Simon Waight's Presentation on Azure Functions
snippet.description: In this session Simon Waight (Azure MVP) will cover how he has used Azure Functions to build a microservices-based solution for a customer that leverages Azure AD B2C, Service Bus, DocumentDB and KeyVault, along with external integration with Braintree v.zero for payments and Sendgrid for post-transaction notifications.
